content: Prisma migrate dev vs migrate deploy: dev prompts for new migrations and accepts data loss on drift; deploy applies pending migrations non-interactively and aborts on conflicts, should run in CI/CD not locally. In monorepos with shared DB, Prisma uses advisory locking during migrate deploy to prevent concurrent runs; best practice is to attach migrate deploy to exactly one app/pipeline step that runs before others start. Pinning the Prisma engine/CLI version in CI avoids binary mismatches between local dev and CI runners.
